description:
How many bedrooms homes have: studios through six or more, for all dwellings and separately for houses, townhouses and apartments, plus people per bedroom, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,700 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/bedrooms`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**
